title: Severability.
bodyText: Any provision of this chapter that is held invalid as to any person or circumstance shall not affect the application of any other provision of this chapter that can be given full effect without the invalid provision or application.
bodyHtml: [§327L-22]  Severability.  Any provision of this chapter that is held invalid as to any person or circumstance shall not affect the application of any other provision of this chapter that can be given full effect without the invalid provision or application. [L 2018, c 2, pt of §3]
